The dealer wins, you lose 100, and you have 1,400 chips. You Hit me again. You can't take another hit. You busted at 28, so round 2 is over and the dealer took the 100. You have 1,400 chips . To play again, tap Deal again on the table. Round 3 will start at 1,400, and you can set a new bet there. Your bet is 75. You have 15 and the dealer shows a 10. What's your move? You Split if you can, otherwise stand. You can't split, so you stand on 15. The dealer has 17 and wins. You lose 75 and have 1,325 chips.
